E0606

Ambiguous name: module (lists every matching path)

What

Ambiguous name: module (lists every matching path)

Why

A module name must lead to exactly one file, and this one matches several

Fix

Rename one module or remove the duplicate module path so only one matching path remains.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0606: tests/ui/import_ambiguous/stderr.

Error [jet.AmbiguousModule]: The module name `dup` matches more than one file
  --> tests/ui/import_ambiguous/run.jet:1:5
    |
  1 | use dup
    |     ^^^
 Why: Module imports must name exactly one file under the project root
 Fix: Pick one file and use a file import instead: dup.jet, lib/dup.jet
